stackDivergence.rationale: Native owner boundaries, complete token/namespace identities and original factory generators are retained. Browser maps, immutable lexical URI strings and byte arrays bind generated gperf/UTF8/component transport; actual existing OOXMLValue/UNO/RTL/SAX owners provide typed conversions and model dispatch.

local.marker: regenerates every consumed table through unchanged pinned native generators

preservedResponsibilities: Consumed generated wml factory methods retain singleton identity, source schema attribute order, exact list/element/resource switch/default behavior, unchanged failure output cells and original attribute-action calls. Native NMSP/XML constant expressions bind their original complete token/namespace IDs. Root fallback surprise is preserved in WRITER097. Full native schema surface and unconsumed stream/table/drawing/actions are not advertised.

Consumed native start/end/character actions now dispatch in original order with original resource-ID guards. Generation rejects unconsumed action names and conditional handlers before they reach runtime.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed native interfaces, component services, C++ ABI and native memory/thread/performance contracts remain outside this consumed binding.
Document/style/list/table/section/theme SAX contexts, complete canonical DOCX model import/export and existing UI integration remain pending in V4DQJW.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The native OOXMLFactory_wml.cxx is a build-generated product of factoryimpl_ns.py rather than an authored corpus file. The runtime namespace owner and its constant records are separated at the generated-resource boundary; both remain traced directly to the unchanged native generator and model.
